en.when: this roleplay explicitly uses an RPG System and this tracker prompt is enabled; append exactly one marker to every assistant response
en.dont: a roleplay without explicit levels, XP, inventory and skills, or any value not established by the preset, user or narrative
en.legend:
Always append one complete marker. Copy the newest VLD_SYSTEM snapshot and change only facts established by this response. Use M=sync when nothing deserves a visible notice; sync is invisible. Visible M: xp, loot, skill, level, status, notice.
T short notice title, D one sentence, P highlighted item/skill/result; leave them blank for sync. L current level, X current XP, G next-level XP goal. Never calculate or invent a system the roleplay does not maintain.
I inventory entries separated by ; as name~quantity~rarity. K skills as name~element~rank. C objective conditions as name~effect. Any count is allowed. Keep names in the roleplay language. A numeric gain/change when useful.
FX exactly one of neutral, fire, ice, storm, holy, shadow, poison, gold, danger. Suggested skill elements: fire, ice, storm, holy, shadow; condition effects: burn, poison, freeze, bleed, stun. Never assign the player emotions, intentions or choices.

example.D: The cathedral guardian fell before the final bell.

ru.when: ролевая явно использует RPG-Систему и этот промпт включён; добавляй ровно один маркер в конец каждого ответа
ru.dont: ролевая без явных уровней, опыта, инвентаря и навыков либо сведения, не установленные пресетом, пользователем или сюжетом
ru.legend: Добавляй полный VLD_SYSTEM к каждому ответу: копируй последний снимок и меняй только подтверждённые факты. M=sync невидим; видимые M: xp, loot, skill, level, status, notice. T заголовок, D одна фраза, P главное; для sync пусто. L уровень, X опыт, G цель, A числовое изменение. I: имя~количество~редкость через ; K: имя~стихия~ранг; C: имя~эффект. FX: neutral, fire, ice, storm, holy, shadow, poison, gold, danger. Не выдумывай механику и эмоции игрока.

example.D: Страж собора пал до последнего удара колокола.

preview.D: The cathedral guardian fell before the bell completed its final toll.
The lockbox contained a key that remains warm in open air.
The remembered pattern answers heat with written flame.
The seventh ring fractures and reforms around a new core.
Foreign venom is spreading from the wound.
The lower archive now answers the Ashen Key.
